title: Implement shared cross-kind mechanic primitives and parser normalization
description:
Replace duplicated spell / creature / hazard / feature / magic-item parsing of
recurring mechanics with shared normalized primitives implemented against the A1
IR.

Root cause: separate projectors drift. The half-damage-on-success bug reproduced
independently in creatures, hazards, spells, features, and ancestries is direct
proof — the same printed phrase ("half as much damage on a successful one")
projects differently depending on which projector saw it.

Shared primitives required for at least: attacks and alternate attack modes;
checks, contests, and ability alternatives; saves, multiple saves,
failure/success outcomes, and repeat saves; damage/healing, riders, recurrence,
pools, reductions, and alternatives; action, bonus action, reaction,
legendary-action, and controlled-entity budgets; resources, usage limits,
recharge, reset, and scaling; geometry, range, targets, cover, movement, and
forced movement; conditions, active effects, duration, immunity, termination,
and concentration; options, variants, prerequisites, selection ownership, and
conditional grants; entity creation, summoning, transformation, ownership, and
destruction; currency, inventory, XP, downtime, and persistent ledgers.

Normalization required BEFORE semantic parsing: Unicode minus / en-dash / hyphen
variants, punctuation, range notation, multiplication symbols, parenthetical
alternatives, and wrapped headings.

Closes findings: F-25, F-27, F-28, F-29, F-31, F-32, F-34, F-01, F-08, SOL-005,
SOL-006, SOL-007, CAP-003, CAP-004, Fable F2, Fable F3.
design:
Verified membership evidence for the driving defect (main @4384f25): records whose
prose mentions half damage but carry no typed success branch —
creature 77, hazard 9, spell 9, plus ancestry:dragonborn,
feature:hunter:superior-hunters-defense, feature:monk:evasion and 5 more
(8 "other"). Typed success fields that DO exist in the pack today:
damageOnSuccess, onSuccessfulSave, successfulSaveDamage, noDamageInsteadOfHalf,
successReductionDice, onSuccess, onSuccessOrFailure.

NOTE: the plan states "79 creature + 8 hazard". A coarse whole-record regex over
main gives 77 creature / 9 hazard. The exact membership MUST be re-derived by a
committed clause-level predicate, not copied from the plan or from this note.
Spell and ancestry/feature members are additional to the plan's stated counts and
must not be dropped.
acceptance_criteria:
- Save branches, attacks, damage, range, geometry, usage, duration, and alternatives share one cross-kind projection path.
- The same source phrase cannot project differently by record kind without an explicit, reviewed override.
- Corpus-wide mismatch predicates exist for every recurring mechanical pattern, not per-example assertions.
- Regression coverage includes every brittle parser shape from Opus F-25 through F-35.
- Unicode-minus, alternate range notation, and parenthetical alternate bonuses cannot silently drop a value.
notes:
Bead-writing contract (plan §VI) — this bead must state: exact scope membership
(explicit records/clauses or a deterministic query that enumerates them), root
cause, required invariant, source evidence, pack evidence, engine boundary,
regression predicate + committed assertions, generated outputs, no-repeat alias
list, and completion proof. "Fix the examples above" is not acceptable scope;
close the whole semantic class and reconcile exact membership.
DECOMPOSITION WATCH: this bead spans lexical/Unicode normalization AND nearly
every shared mechanical projector. Convert to an epic with separate children
(normalization layer vs each primitive family) if scoping confirms that breadth.

COUNT HYGIENE: every number in this bead is a SNAPSHOT at commit 4384f25. The
generated ledger/predicate is authoritative. No acceptance test may require a
hand-copied number (e.g. 391, 399, 77, 79).
